classification.difficultyReason: Calculate the rectangle's perimeter and use the six equal sides of a regular hexagon to find its side length.

content.prompt: The perimeters of the two shapes are equal. Work out the side length of the regular hexagon.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 6 paired rectangle and regular hexagon.
spec.description: An unshaded rectangle on the left and an unshaded regular hexagon on the right, with their centres horizontally aligned. The rectangle's left side is labelled 2 cm and its bottom side is labelled 10 cm. The hexagon has horizontal top and bottom edges and no dimension labels.
spec.mathematics: The rectangle has perimeter 24 cm. The regular hexagon has six equal sides and the same perimeter. Diagram proportions follow the source rather than asserting a scale.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied rectangle dimensions are visible; the unknown hexagon side length is omitted.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}P&=2(10)+2(2)\\P&=24\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

Let $x$ be the hexagon's side length in centimetres. Its six sides are equal.

$$\begin{align*}P&=6x\\24&=6x\\x&=4\end{align*}$$

The side length is $4\text{ cm}$.
